dialogs.resetDetails: This will remove Open WebUI Tether’s installed runtimes and packages, settings, saved connections, and local sign-in data. Open WebUI Tether will restart. Your hosted WebUI data and personal files will not be deleted.
dialogs.installDetails: Install Open Terminal to enable local capabilities in Open WebUI.
dialogs.uninstallDetails: This stops local terminals, disables local access and removes the Open Terminal package. Your files, saved WebUI connections and shared Python runtime are kept.
settings.terminal.httpAccessDesc: Off by default when IPC is supported. Older versions use authenticated localhost HTTP. Changing HTTP settings restarts Open Terminal and interrupts active sessions.
settings.terminal.httpFallback: This Open Terminal version does not support IPC. Open WebUI Tether is using authenticated localhost HTTP even with this setting off. Update Open Terminal to use private IPC.
settings.terminal.httpNetworkDesc: Other devices can connect using this computer’s network address and API key. HTTP traffic is unencrypted.
settings.terminal.httpCredentialsDesc: Copies access for the selected connection. The port and key change after restart. For other devices, replace 127.0.0.1 with this computer’s network address.
